ROUND 3 — what changed

· Alerts get the column. The card variant is gone (still in git history).

· A zero is plain text now — no amber, no glyph. Nothing to look at is not a warning. See Quiet night.

· "You owe" is off the strip: it printed the same ISK as the Mining tax card's own tile, two panels apart.

· The rail gains an Alerts entry with an unread count — the feed had no way to be reached from anywhere but the dashboard.

WHERE THE NOTIFICATIONS WENT

Today the Notification Feed renders in exactly one place: inside routes/Overview.tsx. No page, no nav entry, and NOTIFICATION_FALLBACK_ROUTE is /overview — so a tapped push with no route of its own lands on the dashboard.

Summarising it into a column would have stranded everything the column does not list. So the feed gets a page:

· Every type, every Character on the device — the board is active-character-only, the feed never was
· Search, character filter, severity and muted-type filters
· Expand a type to see its individual fires, each with who it belongs to and its own dismiss
· Mute a type or dismiss the whole group from the row — the controls NotificationContextMenu already offers
· Links out to Settings for the per-event toggles, which stay where they are

The column on the board is the summary; this is the detail. That is the relationship every other card on the board has with its page — alerts were the only domain without one.

STILL OPEN

1. Multi-character. The board is the active pilot; the feed is device-wide. The "your other characters" line is a proposal, not a decision.

2. Deep links. "Undercut 21" would open /market?section=orders — no route today opens it pre-filtered to undercut, or jumps to one colony.

3. Does this replace Overview, or sit above it? The wallet panel, skill-queue panel and count tiles are all gone.

4. Where does Alerts sit in the rail? Drawn directly under Overview; the Social group (mail, calendar, contacts) is the other candidate.
